# Add and edit categories and tags

Labels sort your content. Tidewater's posts have an author and a topic. Yours may be called Categories, Tags or
something else. They all work the same way, and this guide uses **Topics** as the example.

After reading this guide, you will know:

- Where your labels are.
- How to add, rename and delete one.
- What happens to pages that use a label you change.

## 1. Find your labels

Each list of labels has its own place in the sidebar, under **Content**, next to the collections. Choose **Topics** to
see every topic. **Search** narrows the list as you type.

## 2. Add a label

1. Choose the button at the top right, for example **New topic**.
2. Fill in the fields. A label usually has a title and a short web address (the slug).
3. Choose **Save**.

## 3. Rename a label

Open the label from the list, change its title, and choose **Save**.

A label is shared, so the new name appears on every page that uses it. You do not have to visit those pages.
Labels have no drafts: a saved change is live at once.

## 4. Put a label on many pages

In a collection's list, tick several entries and choose the action that adds a label. Pick the label and confirm. See
[Entries](entries.md#1-the-listing).

## 5. Delete a label

Open the label and choose **Trash**. It leaves the site and waits in the trash. See
[Restore something you deleted](trash.md) to bring it back.

> [!WARNING]
> Pages that use the label are affected while it is in the trash. Nibble tells you how many other records use it
> before you confirm.
